name: KOFOLA CESKOSLOVE. KC 50
summary: Kofola ČeskoSlovensko a.s. is a producer and distributor of non-alcoholic beverages in Central and Eastern Europe. Their product portfolio includes Kofola, a popular cola-flavored drink, as well as other soft drinks and mineral waters. Kofola ČeskoSlovensko a.s. is headquartered in Krnov, Czech Republic.
